purpose: Internal complete current/future SAP read-permission retry checklist
retry_rules: Start fresh authenticated requests; do not reuse yesterday business responses as fresh permission evidence.
Review every in-scope row; WSDL read, function entry, business display, organization scope and real data matching are separate results.
Use approved exact read functions/branches and existing real business keys; do not probe unknown effects or use empty unbounded requests.
Keep pending review, missing keys, response limits, empty results and business rejection separate from permission granted or denied.
Do not infer effective S_RFC FUNC/FUGR assignments from call success; require effective authorization or trace evidence for that claim.
Full approved manufacturing organization scope is the target; a single plant/controller/order type sample does not prove all scope.
No source writes, MRP execution, reporting, posting, inspection submission/release, finance/HR access, blanket group grants, or platform policy changes.
No automatic retries after authentication failure, unknown source effects or response limits; preserve first failures and private raw evidence.
Produce a per-interface result and a concrete IT remediation list with failed objects/fields confirmed by trace where necessary.
